# The D2D Experts

> > The D2D Experts is the premier resource for door-to-door sales training, leadership development, and industry insights, founded by Sam Taggart and featuring interviews with top performers from companies like Vivint and the solar industry.

The site serves as a comprehensive knowledge hub for the door-to-door sales community, offering strategic frameworks, mindset training, and practical advice from industry leaders. It supports D2D professionals at all levels—from new reps to sales executives—with content focused on recruitment, sales techniques, business building, and personal development.

## Key Topics

- Door-to-door sales (D2D)
- Sam Taggart
- Sales leadership and team building
- Solar sales strategies
- D2DCon (industry conference)
- Sales mindset and mental toughness
- Recruitment and team scaling
- Entrepreneurship in D2D
- Sales training frameworks
- Customer trust and value building
- Virtual selling techniques
- Goal setting and personal development
- Vivint sales methodologies
- Problem-solving in sales
- Business strategy and planning

## Getting Started & Business Fundamentals

- [Guide About to Starting a Door to Door Sales Business 2025](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/how-to-start-a-door-to-door-sales-company): Complete guide to launching a D2D sales business in 2025
- [D2D Recruitment 101: How to Recruit Door to Door Sales Reps Fast](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/how-to-recruit-a-door-to-door-team-fast): Sam Taggart's strategies for fast D2D team building and recruitment
- [How A Comprehensive Marketing And Sales Plan Can Help You in 2024?](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/creating-a-comprehensive-marketing-and-sales-plan-a-personal-perspective): Strategic sales and marketing planning guide for D2D business success

## Sales Leadership & Team Management

- [Leadership In Door To Door Sales](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/leadership-in-door-to-door-sales): Leadership principles for D2D sales using John Wooden's pyramid
- [Mastering Consistency and Beating Decision Fatigue with Mike Brand](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/dont-let-yourself-suffer-from-decision-fatigue-mike-brand-director-of-sales-vivint): Vivint's Mike Brand on managing decision fatigue in sales leadership
- [Jason Newby - Learning To Adapt To Different Markets](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/jason-newby-learning-to-adapt-to-different-markets): Vivint's Jason Newby on adapting to different D2D sales markets

## Mindset & Personal Development

- [Mastering Positivity and Mindset with Dr. Paul Jenkins](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/maximizing-the-power-of-positivity-and-the-mind-dr-paul-jenkins): Dr. Paul Jenkins on mindset control and positivity in D2D sales
- [Discovering Your 'Why' with Sam Taggart](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/sam-taggart-know-your-why): Sam Taggart on finding your motivation and purpose in sales
- [Train the Brain More Than Enough - Tony Child](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/train-the-brain-more-than-enough-tony-child): Tony Child on mindset training to exceed D2D sales targets
- [Overcoming Hardship and Building Success in Door-to-Door Sales](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/building-a-positive-mindset-after-hardship-in-direct-sales-tyler-melton): Tyler Melton on building positivity after hardship in roofing sales
- [The Winning Sales Mindset Behind a First Time Golden Door Winner](https://thed2dexperts.com/blog/the-winning-sales-mindset-behind-a-first-time-golden-door-winner): Dallin Peterson's first-time Golden Door win using mental toughness
